title: Meta earnings: Analyst says it's 'throwing spaghetti' with AI strategy
excerpt: Meta's AI investments raise concerns as its stock drops 10%. Analysts question the strategy, while CEO Mark Zuckerberg sees growth in AI technology.
content_html:
Meta's AI strategy is, once again, worrying investors.

The social media giant's stock tumbled 10% on Wednesday after it disclosed that its capital expenditure growth far outpaced revenue growth.

Meta has a core problem: much of this spending doesn't yet have a financial return. About 98% of Meta's revenue still comes from its traditional ads business, according to its second-quarter results.

Meta has been trying lots of new things lately, like rolling out new subscriptions, smart glasses, and apps. It's also weighing selling AI compute to other companies. All these moves leave its actual AI strategy unclear, EMARKETER senior analyst Minda Smiley said.

"These continuous rollouts increasingly feel more like the company is throwing spaghetti at the wall instead of rallying around a sustainable way forward," she wrote in a note.

A Meta spokesperson told Business Insider that Meta's AI investments supercharge its business by helping teams build faster and customers advertise better. For example, 9 million small businesses use Meta's AI image-editing tools. Also, since adding its latest AI model, Muse Spark, the company has seen a 60% increase in the number of people interacting with its AI assistant each day, the spokesperson added.

On the earnings call, CEO Mark Zuckerberg also made the case that it's still early in Meta's AI journey. He said that Meta is working on significantly more powerful AI models that will drive future revenue growth, and touted Meta's most recent AI model releases, which performed well on industry rankings.

Zuckerberg predicted a future where billions of people use personal AI agents operating 24/7 to improve their personal lives and careers, although he said that Meta hasn't quite made that a reality yet.

Wall Street's patience is wearing thin. Thomas Monteiro, a senior analyst at Investing.com, said in a note that Meta's ads revenue — which is still growing at a healthy clip — won't make up for all the AI spending.

"The harder truth is that even strong ads are not enough considering the expenses outlook," he wrote.

It's still far too early to count Meta out. On the earnings call, Zuckerberg stressed that he didn't view Meta as just an ads business. He cited Meta's long history of building its own technology, from creating Facebook in his Harvard dorm room to building data centers now.

"We really are a full-stack technology company," he said.

content_html_zh:
Meta 的人工智能策略再次让投资者感到担忧。

这家社交媒体巨头披露其资本支出增长远远超过收入增长后，周三股价暴跌 10%。

Meta 有一个核心问题：大部分支出尚未产生财务回报。 根据第二季度业绩，Meta 约 98% 的收入仍然来自传统广告业务。

Meta 最近一直在尝试很多新事物，比如推出新的订阅、智能眼镜和应用程序。 它还在考虑向其他公司出售人工智能计算。 EMARKETER 高级分析师 Minda Smiley 表示，所有这些举措都使其实际的人工智能战略尚不清楚。

她在一份报告中写道：“这些持续的推出越来越让人感觉公司是在往墙上扔意大利面条，而不是团结在可持续的前进道路上。”

Meta 的一位发言人告诉《商业内幕》，Meta 的人工智能投资通过帮助团队更快地构建和客户更好地做广告来增强其业务。 例如，900 万家小型企业使用 Meta 的 AI 图像编辑工具。 此外，发言人补充说，自从添加最新的人工智能模型 Muse Spark 以来，该公司每天与其人工智能助手互动的人数增加了 60%。

在财报电话会议上，首席执行官马克扎克伯格也表示，Meta 的人工智能之旅仍处于早期阶段。 他表示，Meta 正在开发更强大的人工智能模型，这将推动未来的收入增长，并称赞 Meta 最新发布的人工智能模型，该模型在行业排名中表现良好。

扎克伯格预测，未来将有数十亿人使用 24/7 全天候运行的个人人工智能代理来改善他们的个人生活和职业生涯，尽管他表示 Meta 尚未完全实现这一目标。

华尔街的耐心正在消失。 Investing.com 的高级分析师托马斯·蒙泰罗 (Thomas Monteiro) 在一份报告中表示，Meta 的广告收入（仍在健康增长）无法弥补所有人工智能支出。

“更残酷的事实是，考虑到支出前景，即使是强有力的广告也是不够的，”他写道。

现在就排除 Meta 还为时过早。 在财报电话会议上，扎克伯格强调，他并不认为 Meta 只是一家广告公司。 他引用了 Meta 构建自己技术的悠久历史，从在哈佛宿舍创建 Facebook 到现在构建数据中心。

“我们确实是一家全栈技术公司，”他说。
